question: What is gram anchoring in DINOv3 doing conceptually?
direct_answer: It regularizes patch tokens so their pairwise relationships stay aligned between student and teacher.
expanded_answer: Gram anchoring matches the student’s patch-token Gram matrix to the teacher’s. A Gram matrix summarizes similarity structure among patch features, so this loss helps preserve dense spatial relationships and stabilizes the learned feature geometry during self-supervised training.
common_wrong_ideas: Thinking it only matches individual token values
Assuming it is mainly about classification logits
